Why buyers choose our garlic

  • Naturally sourced from prime Indian garlic-growing regions
  • Multi-stage drying preserves active allicin and aroma compounds
  • Strict moisture control — ≤6% ensures long shelf life
  • Available in bulk (drums) or retail-ready packaging
  • Consistent batch-to-batch color and particle size
  • Tested for pesticide residue, heavy metals and microbials
